mapper.select: SELECT tm.*, u.user_name, u.avatar, u.age, u.sex, s.name as shopName FROM travel_moments tm LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON tm.user_id = u.user_id left join travel_shop s on tm.shop_id = s.id where tm.id = #{id}

SELECT tm.*, u.user_name, u.avatar, u.age, u.sex, EXISTS (SELECT * FROM travel_like WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND data_id = tm.id AND type = 1) AS isLike, (SELECT count(*) FROM travel_like WHERE data_id = tm.id AND type = 1) as likeNum FROM travel_moments tm LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON tm.user_id = u.user_id where tm.id in
#{dataId}

SELECT tm.*, u.avatar, u.phone, u.user_name, EXISTS (SELECT * FROM travel_like WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND data_id = tm.id AND type = 1) AS isLike, (SELECT count(*) FROM travel_like WHERE data_id = tm.id AND type = 1) as likeNum FROM travel_moments tm LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = tm.user_id where tm.title like concat('%', #{keyword} ,'%') or tm.location like concat('%', #{keyword} ,'%') or tm.province like concat('%', #{keyword} ,'%') or tm.city like concat('%', #{keyword} ,'%') or tm.district like concat('%', #{keyword} ,'%') ORDER BY tm.create_time DESC
